    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
    Repository that also keeps its entities in a text file, one per line.
    Consola
    Console menu of the application.
    Entity<ID>
    Base class of all entities; holds the identifier.
    InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
    Repository that keeps the entities in memory, in a map indexed by id.
    Main
    Starts the application; the repositories are created by the factory.
    Pereche<E1,E2>
    Immutable pair of two values.
    Prietenie
    A friendship between two users; the id is the pair of user ids, smaller id first.
    PrietenieDbRepository
    Skeleton database repository for friendships; implemented in lab 4.
    PrietenieFileRepository
    Text file repository for friendships; line format: id1;id2;date (ISO).
    PrietenieValidator
    Validates friendships: the two user ids must be different.
    Repository<ID,E>
    Generic CRUD repository for entities identified by an id of type ID.
    RepositoryException
    Unchecked exception thrown for persistence and configuration errors.
    RepositoryFactory
    Simple Factory: the only class that knows the concrete repositories.
    RepositoryType
    The persistence type, chosen in config.properties.
    Service
    Business logic: users, friendships and communities.
    ServiceException
    Unchecked exception thrown when a business rule is broken.
    Utilizator
    A user of the social network.
    UtilizatorDbRepository
    Skeleton database repository for users; implemented in lab 4.
    UtilizatorFileRepository
    Text file repository for users; line format: id;firstName;lastName.
    UtilizatorValidator
    Validates users: first and last name must not be blank.
    ValidationException
    Unchecked exception thrown when an entity is not valid.
    Validator<T>
    Validation strategy for entities.
